title: Pull EU order totals for a customer escalation
sql: SELECT c.email, o.total FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.email = 'jane.doe@example.com' AND o.shipping_region = 'EU' -- check Jane's orders

title: Daily order volume for dashboard
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count, currency FROM orders WHERE created_at >= '2026-10-01' GROUP BY currency

title: Merchant tax verification for finance
sql: SELECT m.legal_name, m.tax_id, m.country_code FROM merchants m WHERE m.merchant_id = 88213

title: Export German and French customer records
sql: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE country_code IN ('DE', 'FR')

title: Loyalty program outreach list
sql: SELECT lp.member_email, lp.points_balance FROM loyalty_profiles lp WHERE lp.tier = 'gold' AND lp.points_balance > 5000

title: Support case backlog review
sql: SELECT cust_ref, case_notes FROM support_cases_v2 WHERE opened_by = 'agent_77'

title: Chargeback investigation
sql: SELECT p.card_last4, p.card_brand, p.amount FROM payments p WHERE p.order_id = 'A-1001'

title: Repeat buyers by region (subquery)
sql: SELECT r.shipping_region, COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT o.customer_id, o.shipping_region FROM orders o WHERE o.total > 250) r GROUP BY r.shipping_region

title: Product catalog by category
sql: SELECT title, category, price FROM products WHERE price BETWEEN 10 AND 50 ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 100
